brief.prompt: Hello, dear. It’s Nell. In Chapter 11 it is four to one, and Lucy is the youngest, but she follows the Lion down into the gorge anyway. One by one the others begin to see him: Edmund at the stream, Peter soon after, Susan at last on the hill. Build the path Aslan led them along, from the stepping stones to the hill where the trees woke, and tell me what changed at one stop.
